description: Drive a Preview session: select a module, lesson, or exact item/question; set answers; reset the simulation; expire it; or mint a fresh one-time real-worker-renderer link. Standard sessions also simulate the assignment lifecycle: submit_assessment grades a lesson (answering a submitted lesson opens the next attempt within the attempt policy); grade_manual, release_result and review_lesson (decision PASS/FAIL, reason required for FAIL) act on its latest submitted attempt; approve, return (reason required) and resubmit move the simulated course. The review block shows the employer-side state with aggregate grades and question ids only; nothing durable is written. select_view (view required; nothing else accepted) chooses the frame the hosted renderer shows: WORKER (the worker player, default) or EMPLOYER_REVIEW (the read-only simulated employer-review panel over the simulated attempts — review queue, grading, release, course review; aggregate grades and pinned manual-question prompts only, never answer keys or worker identity); mastery sessions refuse it and observe links always show the worker frame. State mutations require expectedStateRevision and fail closed on drift. Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key. Reuse only for the identical operation.
